segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I wanted to walk through the renewal and the 12 additional seats you mentioned for the field team, and make sure the dates line up for your July rollout.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that works. We have 38 seats today, and we need to be at 50 by July 15. The current term ends August 31, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, August 31. What we can do is add the 12 seats now on a prorated basis through the end of the term, then renew all 50 seats for September 1 through August 31 next year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. What does that do to the invoice? Finance asked me for the actual number, not just the per-seat rate.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: The prorated add-on for July 15 through August 31 is $1,860. The annual renewal for 50 seats is $62,500, billed upfront on September 1. Same support package, same contract terms.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That matches what I expected. We also need the training session before the new reps start using it. Can you do the week of July 8?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. I have Tuesday, July 9 at 1:00 Eastern or Thursday, July 11 at 11:00 Eastern. It’s a 90-minute admin and end-user session, and we’ll record it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Let’s do July 9 at 1:00. Send me the quote with the prorated seats and the renewal together, and I’ll route it for signature.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send one order form showing the $1,860 add-on and the $62,500 renewal, with the July 15 and September 1 start dates called out.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If I get it today, I can probably have it back by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll get it over this afternoon. Thanks, Dana.
